proposals.entity_key: Formation of passé simple for regular -er verbs

evidence.notes: Formation is stated verbatim; no auxiliary precedes the verb, and -âmes/-âtes carry a circumflex.

proposals.entity_key: Formation of passé simple for regular -ir and -re verbs

evidence.notes: Formation is stated verbatim for partir and répondre; endings attach directly to the stem with no auxiliary.

proposals.value: present conditional of auxiliary (avoir/être) + past participle

evidence.notes: Formation is explicit; the auxiliary in the present conditional precedes the past participle and compound-tense agreement rules apply.

proposals.value: present subjunctive of avoir/être + past participle

evidence.notes: Formation is explicit; the same auxiliary as the passé composé is used, with agreement when the auxiliary is être.

proposals.value: subject + auxiliary (avoir/être) in imparfait + past participle

evidence.notes: Formation 'imparfait of avoir/être + past participle'; negation wraps the auxiliary as ne + auxiliary (imparfait) + pas + past participle.
Formation is explicit, e.g. nous chantons -> chantant; -cer/-ger verbs add a spelling change before -ant.

proposals.entity_key: Formation of the present subjunctive for regular verbs
proposals.value: je/tu/il/ils: stem from ils/elles present (drop -ent) + -e, -es, -e, -ent; nous/vous: stem from nous present (drop -ons) + -ions, -iez

evidence.notes: Formation is stated in full; the stem source differs by person, and the nous/vous forms match the imparfait.

proposals.value: tu form (without -s for -er verbs), nous form, vous form

evidence.notes: Formation takes the present-tense tu, nous, vous forms in that order, with the -s dropped for -er verbs in the tu form.
Formation 'si + futur antérieur'; the futur antérieur follows si only when si means whether, not in conditional si clauses.

proposals.entity_key: Futur antérieur for probability of past action
proposals.value: subject + auxiliary in futur simple + past participle

evidence.notes: Parallel to the futur simple of probability, the compound form places the future auxiliary before the past participle; no formation string was given in the context.
